title: Plainproof MCP server review entry (servers/<slug>.json)
description: One entry per server implementation. Every finding rests on the project's own public material and carries its source and the date it was read. See METHODOLOGY.md.

repository_at_selection.description: Address used when the set was selected, if the repository has since been renamed or transferred.

path_in_repository.description: Directory of the reviewed package inside a monorepo.

publisher.description: Owner of the repository on GitHub.

publisher_account_type.description: Account type as reported by GitHub. A fact about the account, not a result.

package.description: How the server is distributed, e.g. npm:<name>; pypi:<name>; oci:<image>; binary:<site>; remote:<url>.

license_spdx.description: Licence identifier as detected by GitHub; NOASSERTION when GitHub detects no standard licence.

commit.description: Commit of the default branch at which repository files were read.

outcome.description: Group computed from results by the rule in METHODOLOGY.md section 5.2.

outcome_statement.description: 'As of <date>: meets ...; partly meets ...; does not meet ....'

finding.description: What the source said, with a quotation where the finding depends on wording.

verified.description: YYYY-MM-DD the source was read, or 'not re-verified YYYY-MM-DD'.

advisories.description: Advisories published in the repository's own advisory list for this server.

third_party_reports.description: Reports by anyone other than the publisher. Never used to decide a result.

status.description: 'reported by <source>, not confirmed in the project's own material'

not_reverified.description: Findings whose source could not be reached on the verification date.

open_disputes.description: Open issues disputing a finding in this entry.
